en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, form Ibn Fazaal, from Ibn Bukeyr, from Zurara who said,

‘I heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Ubeydullah Bin Umar was made to stand, and he had drunk the wine. So Umar instructd that he should be whipped. But no one proceeded anyone to whip him until Ali<sup>asws</sup> arose with a doubled belt, so he<sup>asws</sup> whipped him with it’.
